title: Colonial Gas Company d/b/a/ KeySpan Energy Delivery New England files for review and approval a 365 Day Transportation Agreement with Heffron Asphalt, Corp.
petitioner: Colonial Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department approves the proposed Agreement. The Department fins that the pricing terms of the agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore Grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: James Connelly, Chairman; Commissioners Paul B. Vasington, W. Robert Keating, Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., and Deirdre K. Manning. (GC 01-01)
